preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)
Contract must have accumulated BNB from transaction fees in its balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(false) to disable automatic fee processing, then repeatedly transfer tokens to trigger the swapAndLiquify function manually. This will convert accumulated tokens to BNB and send 2/3 of the swapped BNB to the marketing address (0x1E0A894269812ae0CeAb7f10e25b885d3beBA110). If the attacker controls the marketing address, they receive the funds directly. Alternatively, the owner can change the marketing address to their own address first using a setter function if available, or simply withdraw accumulated BNB if the contract has a withdrawal function.
